```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))

samples <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(project_folder, sample_file), show_col_types = FALSE)
sample_ids <- unique(samples$sample_id)
```

## Overview

This report covers the **quantify** module: miRNA-level quantification (seqkit,
per-reference read counts) and gene-level quantification (featureCounts) against the
host genome annotation, plus counts over the predicted novel-miRNA loci.

## featureCounts assignment summary (genome, STAR)

```{r fc-summary, results='asis'}
rows <- purrr::map(sample_ids, function(s) {
  path <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "quantify", "star", "genome", sprintf("%s_star_reference_fc.txt", s))
  df <- parse_featurecounts_summary(path)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df$sample_id <- s
  df
})
fc_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
preview_table(fc_summary, n = nrow(fc_summary), caption = "featureCounts assignment summary per sample (genome, STAR)")
```

## Novel-miRNA locus counts

```{r novel-counts, results='asis'}
rows <- purrr::map(sample_ids, function(s) {
  path <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "quantify", "star", "novel_mirna", sprintf("%s_star_novelMirna_bedtools.txt", s))
  df <- safe_read_tsv(path, col_names = FALSE)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(sample_id = s, n_loci = nrow(df), total_reads = sum(df[[ncol(df)]], na.rm = TRUE))
})
novel_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
preview_table(novel_summary, n = nrow(novel_summary), caption = "Reads over predicted novel-miRNA loci per sample")
```

## Runtime and resource usage

```{r runtime}
bench <- discover_benchmarks(project_folder, "quantify")
runtime_table(bench, caption = "quantify module: runtime and peak memory per rule")
resource_allocation_table(bench, "quantify", project_folder,
                           caption = "quantify module: allocated vs. actual resource usage")
```

```{r runtime-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
runtime_plot(bench, title = "quantify module: total runtime per rule")
```
